author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: अप्रकाशः क्षेत्रादिषु शब्दादिज्ञानाभावः । अप्रवृत्तिरनुद्यमः । प्रमादोऽनवधानम् । मोहो विपर्ययः । एतानि तमसि विवृद्धे जायंते । एतैर्लिङ्गैस्तमोविवृद्धिर्ज्ञेयेति भावः ॥ १४.१३॥
translation:
Absence of light, absence of activity, inattention and even misapprehension, — these are born, O Delight of Kurus, when Tamas is increased. (13)
V. Absence of Light: absence of knowledge coming through the various senses.
Such are the indicatory circumstances to know which of the qualities dominate at the time. (13)
A. In the next is shown the difference of goal or destination reached by the different individuals, as this or that quality prevails at the hour of death.
